title: Improve conditional κ to 0.00172009662868483 with shared kernels
body:
The previous fixed-word packing had only about 1e-9 of room above #2848. This contribution changes the literal local words and constructs a new chronological allocation, completing the conditional finite supplier and modern outer release at

`κ = 0.001720096628684832600972 − 10^-46 − 10^-70`.

The exact gain over #2848 (`c50d12e4720cd1fef2b5a65e337e37de9731879a`) is **1438120379902596153 / 10^24 ≈ 1.43812e-6**. The exact comparator also exceeds concurrent #2853 (`d01045dfb67428679618027dff552f1d032fa999`) by about **7.18970e-7**.

### What changes

Only `research/shared-kernel-repacking/` is added. Four staged raw-dirt kernel changes reduce helpers 460/462/478/480 from width 9 to 8. Delaying within-pair mixing and changing the compensation basis gives a paid local delta **12 H1 − 8 H2**, including inverse cleanup. A new T37 fill assigns all **135864 helper roles** in 333 calls, with every idle child charged. The actual full profile and independent exact moment bracket are included.

**Concurrent credit:** @philippeVV's #2853 treats the same four A-phase helper quartets, using a different early-read schedule with delta 20 H1 − 12 H2. No priority or exclusive helper-selection claim is made. This contribution adds the cheaper staged word, new actual owners, exact comparisons and independently implemented checks. Source words are Jeremy Kothe's #2833 at `e9307b48d7d1b690939935ecef0f8e524e6d92f4`; allocation construction credits Marius-Paul Dumitrean's #2843, and the native/outer lineage retains Dugongue, Tekalign and all predecessor notices.

### Evidence

- Full portable replay passed, including two fresh changed-provider native chains, unchanged strict admission predicates, physical/prefix/precision invoices and the modern outer release. Release receipt SHA256: `c052decb90ceae345b398f111781f567fb787309a528877500cf7fe1cff13b3d`.
- Separate exact local, chronological owner, full-pattern primal/dual and integration-derivation checkers. The complete release evidence, source manifests, cache receipt, logs and corruption controls are included.
- The local profile's coverage-law cap is about 0.001758838084; the headline realizes 97.797326789% of it. The tighter changed-inventory fractional cap is 0.001720100805416885927945; the realized gain is 99.71041112% of its available gain over #2848.
- An initial run exposed a no-op inherited geometry mutant: setting call counts to 333 did not alter the new T37 input. The derived test now subtracts one from each actual count and requires a changed input before the unchanged predicate. All six controls remain required; the full replay then passed. Both failed and corrected evidence are preserved.
- Bounded stdlib replay commands are registered in `VERIFY.json`. Metadata and direct executions passed locally on Python 3.13.7. Generic CI targets Python 3.12; no hosted CI or fresh Lean result is claimed. Allocation regeneration compares the complete decompressed payload, with alternate-container and changed-payload controls.

### Scope and remaining work

This is author-checked conditional finite evidence with separate AI-assisted audits, **not** maintainer acceptance or an unconditional theorem. Two retained native chains and the 16-stage retained parent proof are explicitly reused by full-tree source hashes; this is not a cold replay of every predecessor. All inherited all-size compiler, source-access, hosting, precision/tape and analytic obligations remain. No selected record, predecessor package or global priority is modified.

Started from current main, refreshed through `130a7ce63a233e6812b7c037993c721fec827014` (priority revision 5), and rechecked updated open PRs and Discussion #2612 before submission. #2855's newer T372 result is weaker; no global novelty claim follows from this bounded overlap coverage.

Canonical coordination: https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2612#discussioncomment-18963373

Prepared for Yiyang (@Lyy-iiis), with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance for research, implementation, separate construction/audit agents and publication. Apache-2.0; original notices retained. The README supplies exact replay commands, limitations and scoped next questions.

Post-submission overlap readback also found #2856 (`7a43b24c4b6729d171f3a2a11ef3b7dc77aabaa4`), a four-owner vacancy relay on #2853 with reported conditional target `0.001719378870495538841812 − 10^-46 − 10^-70`. Its reported target is below this contribution. It was not used as a source; the package's exact authenticated comparison gates remain the pinned #2848 and #2853 claims. Its reference to the then-local-only Discussion2612 lead now has the public artifact linked above.
